latest_release.name: Delta Lake 4.4.1
latest_release.body:
We are pleased to announce the release of [Delta Lake 4.4.1](https://github.com/delta-io/delta/releases/tag/v4.4.1), a patch release on top of [Delta Lake 4.4.0](https://github.com/delta-io/delta/releases/tag/v4.4.0). This release improves maintenance safety for catalog-managed tables and fixes snapshot construction for tables that use coordinated commits.

## Bug Fixes

* **\[Spark\] Safer maintenance for catalog-managed tables:** Delta extends existing safeguards on catalog-managed tables to prevent dangerous data and metadata cleanup operations. Automatic maintenance operations are skipped so writes can complete successfully without failure.   
* **\[Spark\] S3A Fast Listing:** Fixed an issue that could produce incorrect snapshots. Users can enable fast listing with `delta.enableFastS3AListFrom` again.

## Delta Spark

Delta Spark 4.4.1 is built for [Apache Spark 4.2.0](https://spark.apache.org/releases/spark-release-4-2-0.html), [Apache Spark 4.1.0](https://spark.apache.org/releases/spark-release-4-1-0.html), and [Apache Spark 4.0.1](https://spark.apache.org/releases/spark-release-4-0-1.html). As with Apache Spark, Maven artifacts are published for Scala 2.13.

* Maven artifacts for Spark 4.2.0:  
  * [delta-spark\_4.2\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-spark_4.2_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-client\_4.2\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-client_4.2_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-common\_4.2\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-common_4.2_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-server\_4.2\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-server_4.2_2.13/4.4.1/)  
* Maven artifacts for Spark 4.1.0:  
  * [delta-spark\_4.1\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-spark_4.1_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-client\_4.1\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-client_4.1_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-common\_4.1\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-common_4.1_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-server\_4.1\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-server_4.1_2.13/4.4.1/)  
* Maven artifacts for Spark 4.0.1:  
  * [delta-spark\_4.0\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-spark_4.0_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-client\_4.0\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-client_4.0_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-common\_4.0\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-common_4.0_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-server\_4.0\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-server_4.0_2.13/4.4.1/)  
* Backward-compatibility artifacts without a Spark version in the name default to Spark 4.2.0:  
  * [delta-spark\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-spark_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-client\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-client_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-common\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-common_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-connect-server\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-connect-server_2.13/4.4.1/)  
* Other Maven artifacts:  
  * [delta-contribs\_2.13](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-contribs_2.13/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-storage](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-storage/4.4.1/)  
  * [delta-storage-s3-dynamodb](https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/io/delta/delta-storage-s3-dynamodb/4.4.1/)  
* Python artifact:  
  * [delta-spark](https://pypi.org/project/delta-spark/4.4.1/)

The fixes and behavior changes in this release are:

* **Safer maintenance for catalog-managed tables** ([\#7603](https://github.com/delta-io/delta/pull/7603)): Catalog-managed tables require the catalog to control destructive maintenance. Delta now rejects unsupported direct data cleanup, data reorganization, and transaction-log cleanup before changing the table. This release blocks
